ddl: CREATE TABLE answer_keys(test_id INTEGER NOT NULL,skill TEXT NOT NULL,config TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(test_id,skill))

CREATE TABLE attempt_progress(
    attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES attempts(id),
    stage TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(stage IN ('NOT_STARTED','LISTENING_ACTIVE','LISTENING_COMPLETED','READING_ACTIVE','READING_COMPLETED','WRITING_ACTIVE','COMPLETED')),
    deadline INTEGER,audio_duration REAL,audio_position REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    audio_observed_at INTEGER,lease_owner TEXT,lease_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  , pending_section TEXT, instructions_confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, completion_acknowledged INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE attempts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),test_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(test_id BETWEEN 1 AND 20),started_at TEXT NOT NULL,submitted_at TEXT,data TEXT,released INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, assignment_id TEXT REFERENCES test_assignments(id), mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'full' CHECK(mode IN ('full','listening','reading','writing')), purpose TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy' CHECK(purpose IN ('fresh','repeat','legacy')))
CREATE TABLE audit(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,actor_id TEXT,event TEXT NOT NULL,target_id TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE login_limits(account TEXT PRIMARY KEY,failures INTEGER NOT NULL,reset_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE module_exposures(
    attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES attempts(id),candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    test_id INTEGER NOT NULL,skill TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(skill IN ('listening','reading','writing')),
    first_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,certainty TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(certainty IN ('seen','uncertain')),
    source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source IN ('history','activation')),PRIMARY KEY(attempt_id,skill))
CREATE TABLE notification_outbox(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,submission_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES attempts(id),event TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,delivered_at TEXT)
CREATE TABLE results_migrations(name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,applied_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE sessions(token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "test_assignments"(
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
        test_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(test_id BETWEEN 1 AND 20),assigned_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT,
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('ASSIGNED','IN_PROGRESS','SUBMITTED','REVOKED')),
        attempt_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(attempt_limit=1),
        attempts_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(attempts_used BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
        mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'full' CHECK(mode IN ('full','listening','reading','writing')), purpose TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fresh' CHECK(purpose IN ('fresh','repeat')),
        UNIQUE(candidate_id,test_id,mode))

CREATE TABLE users(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,registration_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,contact TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('student','admin')),password_hash TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX active_assignment_attempt ON attempts(assignment_id) WHERE submitted_at IS NULL AND assignment_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX candidate_module_exposure ON module_exposures(candidate_id,test_id,skill)
CREATE INDEX student_attempts ON attempts(student_id,test_id)

CREATE TABLE categories(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', icon TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'book', position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, parent_id TEXT REFERENCES categories(id))
CREATE TABLE learning_audit(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,event TEXT NOT NULL,target_id TEXT,details TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE learning_content(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN('course','module','question')),parent_id TEXT REFERENCES learning_content(id),title TEXT NOT NULL,slug TEXT NOT NULL,category_id TEXT REFERENCES categories(id),topic_id TEXT REFERENCES topics(id),difficulty TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN('draft','published','archived')),data TEXT NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(kind,slug))
CREATE TABLE learning_enrolments(student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students(id),course_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES learning_content(id),created_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(student_id,course_id))

CREATE TABLE learning_media(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL,disk_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,mime TEXT NOT NULL,bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,created_by TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE learning_settings(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE lesson_completions(student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students(id),lesson_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES lessons(id),completed_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(student_id,lesson_id))

CREATE TABLE lessons(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,topic_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES topics(id),title TEXT NOT NULL,instructions TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',published INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(published IN (0,1)),version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'practice-set' CHECK(kind IN('lesson','practice-set','assessment')), course_id TEXT REFERENCES learning_content(id), module_id TEXT REFERENCES learning_content(id), difficulty TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')
CREATE TABLE mock_links(student_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES students(id),candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,linked_at TEXT NOT NULL,linked_by TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE partial_bookings(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students(id),slot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES partial_slots(id),module TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(module IN('listening','reading','writing')),test_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(test_id BETWEEN 1 AND 5),test_date TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(student_id,module,test_id))
CREATE TABLE partial_candidates(student_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES students(id),candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)

CREATE TABLE partial_slots(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,module TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(module IN('listening','reading','writing')),test_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(test_id BETWEEN 1 AND 5),test_date TEXT NOT NULL,open INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(open IN(0,1)),created_by TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(module,test_id,test_date))
CREATE TABLE password_resets(token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students(id),expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE practice_answers(attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES practice_attempts(id),question_id TEXT NOT NULL,answer_json TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(attempt_id,question_id))

CREATE TABLE practice_attempts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students(id),lesson_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES lessons(id),lesson_version INTEGER NOT NULL,started_at TEXT NOT NULL,submitted_at TEXT,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('in-progress','completed','pending-review')),question_count INTEGER NOT NULL,correct_count INTEGER,elapsed_seconds INTEGER,result_json TEXT,question_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, policy_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}')

CREATE TABLE practice_set_questions(set_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES lessons(id),question_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES learning_content(id),position INTEGER NOT NULL,marks REAL NOT NULL CHECK(marks>0),PRIMARY KEY(set_id,question_id),UNIQUE(set_id,position))

CREATE TABLE profiles(student_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES students(id),mobile TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',dob TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',country TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',level TEXT NOT NULL,goal TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE questions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,lesson_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES lessons(id),position INTEGER NOT NULL,content TEXT NOT NULL,key_json TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(lesson_id,position))
CREATE TABLE rate_limits(scope TEXT PRIMARY KEY,count INTEGER NOT NULL,reset_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE scheduled_mock_bookings(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students(id),slot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scheduled_mock_slots(id),module TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(module='full'),test_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(test_id IN(19,20)),test_date TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(student_id,module,test_id))
CREATE TABLE scheduled_mock_candidates(student_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES students(id),candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)

CREATE TABLE scheduled_mock_slots(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,module TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(module='full'),test_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(test_id IN(19,20)),test_date TEXT NOT NULL,open INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(open IN(0,1)),created_by TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(module,test_id,test_date))
CREATE TABLE sessions(token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students(id),expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE student_migrations(version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,applied_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE students(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL,email TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE UNIQUE,password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,joined_at TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN(0,1)))

CREATE TABLE topics(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,category_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories(id),slug TEXT NOT NULL,title TEXT NOT NULL, parent_id TEXT REFERENCES topics(id), position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,UNIQUE(category_id,slug))
CREATE INDEX content_search ON learning_content(kind,status,category_id,topic_id,difficulty,updated_at)
CREATE INDEX learning_audit_time ON learning_audit(created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX learning_lessons ON lessons(kind,published,archived,topic_id,course_id,position)
CREATE INDEX partial_booking_dates ON partial_bookings(test_date,created_at)
CREATE INDEX scheduled_mock_booking_dates ON scheduled_mock_bookings(test_date,created_at)
CREATE INDEX student_history ON practice_attempts(student_id,started_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX student_sessions ON sessions(student_id)
ALTER TABLE practice_attempts ADD COLUMN draft_answers TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
